research_question: State the bounded question this notebook or simulation is allowed to address.
hypothesis: State the pre-execution hypothesis, including the null or expected limitation when applicable.

independent_variables.name: parameter_or_condition_name
independent_variables.definition: Operational definition used by this experiment.

dependent_variables.name: measured_output_name
dependent_variables.definition: Operational definition of the measured output.

controls.name: control_name
controls.purpose: What inference or failure mode this control constrains.
controls.implementation: How the control is implemented or generated.

random_seed.seed_scope: all stochastic notebook cells and generated outputs
random_seed.derivation_policy: Fixed before execution; derived seeds must be deterministic and listed in output manifests.

parameter_space.name: parameter_name
parameter_space.sampling_rule: grid, enumeration, Latin hypercube, fixed list, or other explicit rule

expected_outputs.name: primary_output
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Primary bounded output for the stated question.

decision_rules: Declare in advance how observed outputs map to support, limitation, null, inconclusive, or counterexample status.
blocked_interpretations: Post-hoc expansion beyond the declared parameter space.

immutability.supersession_policy: Do not edit after execution starts; create a new spec_id and link the superseding specification.
